# Laxmi Narsimha Reddy Jammula

> Hands-on Engineering Leader | Architecture & Agentic AI. 14+ years building
> production software -- 8+ hands-on as an engineer and data scientist, then 5+
> leading teams while staying in the architecture and the code. Now building the
> coding-agent systems that do the shipping, and measuring whether they work.

present anywhere on this site.
